title: Repeatable GPS malfunctions on the ranch

tellings.quote: >> supporting GPS malfunctions and is manipulated on Skinwalker Ranch. It just does not operate.

plain: GPS, the satellite system phones and cars use to find their position, fails again and again at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels about it without naming a source. He says GPS there is "manipulated" and "just does not operate," which would mean something at the ranch is interfering with ordinary navigation signals.
